messages.author: 453ddfeccaf29bbb
messages.subject: a few things variational
parts:
hi all,

a few questions:

1. any update on the advi pull request? anything i can help with?

2. did we figure out what to do with documentation that doesn't fit into the manual? (e.g. see attached; these are helpful to understand the advi model-based tests.)

3. on the topic of documentation, here's what i had in mind: a very brief explanation of variational inference and advi in the manual + the interface details in the cmdstan manual. sound good?

4. is there any code for EP in Stan at this point? i'm genuinely interested in studying fullrank advi v. gaussian EP.

cheers
alp
